quality_boundary: Current plan identity kept as published (the Fifth Hirakata City Comprehensive Plan in a three-layer basic-concept / basic-plan / action-plan structure; the basic concept starts in FY2016 and sets no fixed plan period, presenting the future image 『持続的に発展し、一人ひとりが輝くまち 枚方』 and five basic goals; the basic plan covers FY2016-FY2027; the action plan runs in four-year periods, the current Third Action Plan covering FY2024-FY2027, holding 28 policy goals and four plan-promotion units — 32 policy-goal units in total — and 79 policies, all enumerated; the next comprehensive plan, starting FY2028 and now being formulated, is kept only as a separate version), progress governance (annual verification and evaluation of the action plan through internal evaluation and external evaluation by policy evaluators, with the Third Action Plan revised at budget-compilation time, kept as the municipality's own progress-management framework), budget enactment confirmed on the council's official voting-results list (bill 議案第84号, passed as proposed on 2026-03-27, with the wording and the date confirmed directly in that document) with the amount kept at the published sen-yen precision and never expanded into synthetic yen, and settlement totals kept at the published yen precision from the official settlement book (the settlement certification bill 認定第1号 was certified on 2025-10-17 at the September 2025 regular session; the real balance of 1,938,746,472 yen is kept at yen precision as published in the settlement summary document, while the real-balance statement itself in the settlement book remains unconfirmed) without collapsing proposed, enacted, supplementary, or settlement states.
